title: Polystyrene nanoplastics trigger changes in cell surface properties of freshwater and marine cyanobacteria
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01223B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Nigarsan Kokilathasan, Basirath Raoof, Maria Dittrich
Polystyrene nanoplastics altered the surface properties of cyanobacteria without affecting their growth or structure, highlighting their remarkable resilience and adaptive strategies in response to environmental challenges.
